task_specification.objective: Repair the survivor arena's authored spatial presentation and upgrade-choice surface so landmarks, perimeter, collision, and external depth remain readable during movement while choices use a compact visual hierarchy with truthful deltas and complete input focus states.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authored cemetery's broad central mausoleum occlusion and camera framing leave the keeper post and cracked moon bell unreadable from spawn and route views; spatial bindings therefore do not preserve landmark visibility during ordinary traversal.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and native_godot_project/host_godot_boot baselines; do not perform destructive asset surgery or replace the package without explicit package-incompatibility evidence.
Do not add proxy roads, floor patches, duplicated landmark families, or evidence-only instrumentation in place of the player-facing repair.
Defer dense native profiling and unrelated backlog gaps to host validation.

strategy.rationale: Apply a materially different root-cause treatment from prior camera-only tuning: repair the real authored world/spatial owners and their collision, navigation, occlusion, perimeter, and external-depth bindings, then make the actual choice presenter icon-led and transaction-truthful.

code: Run the project's parser/static checks for all modified GDScript and scene resources.
Verify upgrade payloads and rendered rows expose at most three changed stats, never placeholder CURRENT values, and apply through the authoritative run-state transaction.
Verify focus navigation and pointer/gamepad action bindings cover keyboard, mouse, and gamepad without release-build tester_* leakage.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture 1280x720 spawn, critical-route, cardinal-landmark, and choice-page states; replay ordinary movement around each landmark and along the full perimeter while checking runtime digest, scene bounds, collision, navigation, and external-depth metadata.
Host/Tester rerun release_convergence_survivor_hud_presentation_contract and confirm native_godot_project plus host_godot_boot remain passing.

Tester closes finding.arena_landmarks_fully_occluded only after direct black-box traversal and white-box spatial/controller retest; deferred dense-profile and ordinary-wave findings remain host-owned.
visual: Compare spawn, critical-route, and cardinal gameplay captures for readable keeper post, mausoleum, cracked moon bell, cemetery streets, escape lanes, and perimeter/external depth without landmark disappearance or void exposure.

Compare upgrade-choice captures under keyboard focus, mouse hover, and gamepad focus for icon-first hierarchy, compact truthful deltas, visible selected/confirm/cancel feedback, and no stacked prose or clipped content.

done_when: The intact authored map is presented at a larger traversable scale or with an explicit `expand` treatment, and a coherent external world/external depth is visible beyond the playable perimeter.
The keeper post, mausoleum, and cracked moon bell remain readable from spawn, critical-route, and cardinal views; no landmark suffers disappearance or whole-landmark occlusion drift.

Rendered native streets/terrain and additive gameplay collision/navigation agree. Ordinary movement/movement replay cannot pass through landmarks, leave the boundary/perimeter, or expose a visible void.
The camera preserves readable escape lanes and central building/landmark silhouettes without using broad mausoleum collision as a false sightline blocker.

Each upgrade/weapon choice card leads with an authored silhouette or icon, compact stat icons, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas; unchanged, exhaustive, and placeholder CURRENT rows are omitted.

Choice cards provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states while preserving authoritative selection, confirm, cancel, and apply/resume behavior.
Tester can directly retest the spatial route and choice page in the same run through black-box interaction and white-box scene/controller inspection.
tasks.instructions: Inspect and modify the real cemetery scene/spatial contract, arena camera, upgrade-draft scene/presenter, and draft controller. Keep the authored cemetery as one intact authoritative environment; use only candidate-owned outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and bounded visibility handling. Repair the central building/landmark sight lanes so keeper post, mausoleum, and cracked moon bell survive approach, near contact, and departure without disappearance or occlusion drift. Ensure larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, collision, navigation, boundary/perimeter integrity, and ordinary movement/movement replay are measurable. Replace any remaining prose-stacked choice presentation with icon/silhouette-first cards, compact truthful current-to-new deltas capped at three, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus affordances tied to the authoritative upgrade transaction. Do not spend this task on dense profiling or unrelated backlog work.
